name: Sherry Yang
title: Assistant Professor
researchAreas: World models for robot policy learning
fitReason: An especially close methods match for CS researchers interested in training VLA policies through learned video world models, VLM rewards, and physical transfer. The current agenda combines foundation models and decision making rather than treating generated videos alone as robot capability.

physicalEvidence.summary: February 2026 World-Gymnast fine-tunes OpenVLA-OFT with GRPO inside a video world model and tests the policy through the public AutoEval real-robot platform. Actual WidowX arms execute drawer and eggplant pick-and-place tasks. The paper reports groups of ten physical trials repeated five times per policy/task, but this external evaluation service does not establish a robot owned by Yang’s NYU lab or in-person visitor access.

shortVisit.summary: The current homepage gives no explicit external visitor or summer-intern invitation. A current KAIST master’s student independently reports visiting NYU with Yang; this is useful precedent, without a public application route or summer2027 promise, so visit credit remains zero.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct foundation-model, RL and embodied-policy research provides a strong physical-AI methods fit.
scoreReasons.physical: Detailed actual robot evaluation, capped because apparatus is the external AutoEval service rather than verified own-lab hardware.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: A current external master’s visitor is precedent only, without a published recruitment route.
scoreReasons.freshness: Dated February 2026 primary robot study and current university appointment.
